headline: Zoning applications for additions, accessory structures, a pickleball court complex, and garage reconstruction at several addresses.
summary: The board will review continued and new applications for special permits and variances at multiple properties, including an indoor pickleball court complex, home additions, and a garage demolition and reconstruction. The board will also discuss rules, regulations, and fees for comprehensive permits.
items: Approval of the Chair to sign decisions for 22 Calder St., 47 Ye Olde County Rd., 67 Middle St., and 29 Flume Rd.
Continued application of Kayla and Peter Cannavo for a special permit and/or variance to construct an addition at 103 Essex Ave., Map 218, Lots 4&5, R-20 zoning district.

Continued application of Jamie and Benjamin Cevelo for a special permit and/or variances to construct an addition to the home and accessory structure at 21 Walnut St., Map 121, Lot 55, R-20 zoning district.

Continued application of 36 Whittemore St LLC for a special permit and/or variance for change of use and reduction in off-street parking to construct an indoor pickleball court complex at 36 Whittemore St., Map 36, Lot 14, GI zoning district.

New application of Jane and William Dobson for a special permit and/or variance to exceed maximum building height for an accessory structure at 14R Becker Circle, Map 234, Lot 56, R-20 zoning district.
New application of David and Jacquelyn Bell for a special permit and/or variance to demolish and reconstruct an attached garage at 1 Banner Hill Wy., Map 78, Lot 31, R-10 zoning district.
Board discussion: Review of the Rules, Regulations and Fees for MGL, c. 40B, S 21 Comprehensive Permits.
location: Kyrouz Auditorium, City Hall, 2nd Floor, 9 Dale Avenue, Gloucester, MA 01930
